item.title: 15 Cancelled Shows Fans Need to Stop Obsessing Over
item.description: Every time a show gets cancelled, the internet reacts as if something sacred was taken away. Petitions pop up, cast reunions are demanded, and fans insist the series was misunderstood or ahead of its time. Sometimes that’s true. But other times, the obsession lasts far longer than the show ever deserved. Not every cancellation is a tragedy, and not every unfinished story needs revival.
